status: PREPARED — the Product Owner's final ASR engineering proof (2026-10-28): 12 sessions (6 overlap, 6 latency), Speechmatics Enhanced ar_en only, max_delay 0.7, QANDEEL's VAD + ForceEndOfUtterance endpoint; one bounded run after an explicit approval (asr-sm-proof-approval.json). Nothing has been sent.

scope.note: The Product Owner's existing recordings only (one speaker, WhatsApp audio), no new recording, sample 20 not repeated. The overlap mixes are synthetic: they are not a proof of the phone's echo canceller, which stays a pre-launch condition proven on devices when calls are implemented. A pass recommends Speechmatics for production integration; it does not declare production testing complete.

guard.keyFile: ~/.qandeel/speechmatics-api-key.txt (per user, outside the repository; read into memory by the launcher only)
guard.reservation: each session reserves its timeout (the recording's audio + the tail silence + the margin) at the arm's hourly price, and settles at its measured wall time, which bounds the audio Speechmatics can bill

terms.holds: real-time audio is never recorded or stored; it is processed in memory and the transcripts are returned and discarded
clause 10.4: no use of customer data for machine learning or model training unless the workspace opts in (the portal model-training setting)
the model-training opt-in (a 33 % discount) is off by default

settings: the workspace model-training setting stays OFF; the Product Owner confirms it in the approval (modelTrainingOff: true) before the run
real-time only: no batch job is created, so nothing is held for the batch retention of 7 days
no translation, no speaker identification, no audio events
privacy.notes: The Product Owner's recordings, their converted WAVs and the transcripts stay in gitignored directories and are deleted at S8B-01 closure.

arms.role: the production candidate configuration: max_delay 0.7 (Speechmatics' minimum), flexible kept (numbers), Speechmatics' own end-of-utterance trigger off so that QANDEEL's endpoint is the only one

endpoint.note: Two decisions, kept apart so that a fast final never cuts the user: FINALIZE — after finalizeSilenceMs of silence (also at a thinking pause) the gateway sends ForceEndOfUtterance with the silence start as timestamp, and the VAD re-arms on new speech; COMMIT — the Orchestrator commits the turn only after a longer silence (S8B-05 sets it by controlled configuration); the commit cut table is computed locally on the 20 recordings and reported, never sent.

audio.encoding: pcm_s16le, 16 kHz mono (the prepared WAVs and their local mixes)

variants.meaning: QANDEEL's voice 25 dB under the speech for the whole line: a stand-in for the echo canceller's residual
QANDEEL's voice at the speech's level until 0.4 s after the user starts, then stopped: the barge-in path
QANDEEL at the speech level for the whole line: the room condition, reported only

overlap.why: two lines the run transcribed with no word error (§9.17), so a change is the overlap, not the line

latency.why: thinking / reading pauses (05: 780 ms, 17: 600 ms, 09: 580 ms, 02: a mid-sentence end of utterance in §9.17), a self-correction (17), hesitation (16) and numbers spoken digit by digit (11)

baseline.note: The same lines in run s8b01-cp2-asr-sm-po-r1 (§9.17): raw word errors against the reference, and the checks that passed.

acceptance.note: Preregistered. The accuracy rules hold the §9.17 lines to their own results; the speed rules are the contract's E + A budget (bench-plan.json: E ≤ 900 ms, A ≤ 300 ms). FULL_0DB is reported only. The commit cut table is reported, not gated.
